title: Parampara practice cards
description: The response of GET /api/open/cards: approved classroom practices from Karnataka's master teachers, in Kannada and English, under CC BY 4.0. Only the words of each practice and the master's credit as they chose it; never a transcript, recording, teacher or child.

attribution.description: How to credit the collection as a whole. Credit each card with its own `credit` line.

kn.description: Kannada, as the master said it (redacted of any child's name).

Master.description: The master teacher whose practice this is, exactly as they chose to be credited.

name.description: Full name, first name, or null when the master chose to stay anonymous.

id.description: Stable id of the card (a UUID for real cards).

problem.description: The classroom problem the practice solves.

steps.description: What to do, in order. Each step was checked against the master's recorded words before approval.

why.description: Why it works, in one line, when the master said so.

gradeBand.description: One of 1, 2, 3, 1-2, 1-3, any (classes of primary school).

subject.description: One of kannada, maths, english, evs, general.

topic.description: Foundational literacy and numeracy topic: letters, reading, writing, oral_language, number_sense, operations, multi_level, engagement, home_language, parents, classroom, other.

languages.description: BCP 47 codes of the languages every text field carries.

credit.description: A ready attribution line for this card, as CC BY 4.0 asks.

reviewed.description: A human reviewer approved this card.

isSample.description: True for synthetic demonstration cards. Filter these out for real use.
